anuncios.texto:
First-Time Coaches:
Just got asked to coach flag football?
One of the biggest questions new coaches have is...

“What am I actually supposed to do at practice?”

A lot of coaches show up with a bunch of random drills...

And hope it all comes together.

Don't.

Start simple.

Teach one skill.

Rep it.

Build confidence.

Then move to the next thing.

This flag pulling drill is one of the easiest ways to start practice because it gets kids moving, competing and working on one of the most important skills in flag football.

Most first-time coaches don't struggle because they care too little.
